THINKING: In Arabic, the appropriate pronoun to fill the blank depends on the subject mentioned before the blank. In this case, we have "نحن طالبان" which means "we are two students". The correct subject before the blank should be "نحن" (we) as well. So, the correct pronoun should be the one referring to the same subject.

ANSWER: الضمير المناسب هو "بَيْنا" لأنه يشير to "نحن" (we).

FINAL: بينا
